create_grok2_tokenizer: create a Grok2Tokenizer instance from a local path or Hugging Face repo ID using from_pretrained
encode_text_grok2: encode a text string into a list of token IDs using the Grok2Tokenizer encode method
decode_tokens_grok2: decode a sequence of token IDs back into text using the Grok2Tokenizer decode method
apply_chat_template_grok2: apply a chat template to a list of message dicts and optionally tokenize the result with Grok2Tokenizer
convert_tokens_to_ids_grok2: convert a token string or list of tokens to their corresponding integer IDs with Grok2Tokenizer
